bdud rtsis bsang sbyang la/ oṃ u tsuṣ+ma bai ta li kro ta sarba dra byam sho dha na hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes kyis: chos rnams thams cad sgyu mar rig: rig pa ye shes raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: tshogs kyi dngos po bsregs sbyangs bkrus: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: tshogs spyan 'dren ni/ bh+yo: bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga dang: bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis dang: ma gcig lha mo dud sol rgyal mo dang: lha mo e ka dzā ṭi dang: dbang phyug sde brgyad yang 'khor 'bum: ye shes rol pa'i tshogs la gshegs: dam tshig dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir bzhugs: bdag cag gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: mdzes snyan dri zhim ro mngar zhing: reg bde glu gar chos yid tshim: 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod pa bzhes: mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod sbyar ba: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'phro: 'dod yon lha mos rab brgyan 'bul: dam bskang dgyes pa chen por rol: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga/ bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis/ ma gcig lha mo dud sol/ sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi/ dbang phyug sde brgyad yang 'khor 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du ga ṇa tsakra la kha raṃ khā hi: zhes tshogs 'bul lo// lnga pa skong ba ni/ hūm̐: thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i lha tshogs ni: bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga'i thugs dam bskang: bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis thugs dam bskang: lha mo dud sol rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang: sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi'i thugs dam bskang: dbang phyug yang 'khor 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang: thugs dam gnyan po skong ba'i dam rdzas ni: rgyu mchog chen po rnam lnga dang: mchog chen mchog phran mtshan ldan dang: rang byung dam rdzas bdud rtsi dang: rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang: rak+ta dmar gyi dgyes mchod dang:

snang gsal 'od kyi zhun mar dang: sha chen spos kyi dam rdzas dang: rnal 'byor tshogs kyi longs spyod dang: mkha' lding mdangs dang shel sgong mdangs: tsa ra 'di yi mdangs kyis bskang: 'di ltar bskangs bskangs gsol gsol nas: thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig: cho ga lhag chad rdzogs gyur cig: g.yar dam bskangs la rkyen rnams zlogs: dmigs pa'i dgra bo myur du sgrol: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: rnal 'byor nyams chag bskang bar mdzod: de nas drug pa mdos bsngo'o//
